mechanics.claim: During Possession, Viego gains the possessed champion's items, basic attacks, basic abilities and base stats, replacing his own kit for the duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}}, [[item]]s (excluding [[trinket item]]s), and base [[champion statistic|stats]]

mechanics.claim: The possessed champion's abilities cost no mana or energy, though alternative resources like Fury, Flow, or Health are still used.
mechanics.quote: The possessed champion's abilities do not cost any {{tip|mana}} or {{tip|energy}} even if that specific champion normally uses either as a [[casting resource]].

mechanics.claim: Viego cannot use the possessed champion's item actives or consumables during Possession.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' cannot use the possessed champion's [[Active ability items|item actives]] or [[consumable item]]s

mechanics.claim: Consuming a Mist Wraith or casting Heartbreaker ends Possession immediately.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' ends ''Possession'' immediately.

mechanics.claim: Viego's own ability cooldowns are not reset between transformations, but the possessed champion's ability cooldowns are reset when Possession begins.
mechanics.quote: The current cooldowns of '''Viego's''' abilities will '''not''' be reset between transformations. ** Those of the possessed champion's abilities will be reset between transformations.

mechanics.claim: Viego preserves his current health percentage when transforming between his own form and a possessed form.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' will preserve his {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} between transformations.
